683. *Wither skeleton blows through a raised shield: the quarter second a shield takes to block, opened at every asking (the live critic's report artifacts/critic/critic-20260929T1923Z.md, item 3: 25598 mid-242-ee-fortress-18, 18:57:07 to 09Z, 20 to 13.3 to 6.6 to none, each hurt printed "(shield up)" by recent.js under shield_guard at 0.96; also 19:01:44 and 19:22:41; flight record 127_0_0_1-25598-Jev-2026-09-29T18-46-10-888Z, read by script).* **What the bot did.** Digging down toward a blaze, a wither skeleton came within six ("Preempted by newcomer", 18:57:06.6); encounter_stance was asked; the first blow landed at 07.310, 17 ms after the swing reflex that runs while a question is out (combat.js defendNearby, `survivalAction: defend` at 07.293) had lowered the shield, struck and raised it again. shield_guard was answered at 08.488 and the second blow landed at 08.724; the guard stopped at six health lost, it was asked again and answered at 09.729, and the third landed at 09.778. The skeleton was 2.0 blocks off each time and the bot faced it to within a degree (yaw against the skeleton's bearing in the frames). **Root cause.** A raised shield blocks only once it has been in use five ticks (the 26.1.2 jar: the shield's blocks_attacks, block_delay_seconds 0.25), and three things lowered it with the skeleton at arm's length: the swing reflex during the asking (lower, ready a strike, raise), the survival step's start (`lowerShield` before every branch, "a raised shield is sneaking speed"), and the stance's entry (`lowerShield` for every stance not a shot), so each re-asking of shield_guard was the question's time plus a quarter second with no block; and "(shield up)" was the flag, raised in the same few milliseconds as the blow (the damage frame is taken after the reflex). Not the cause, measured: facing (of the 281 melee hits over all flight records with the shield flag up in the frame before, 225 came from the front half, 38 from behind, 18 not placed), flanking (one biter in all three 25598 cases), or the server's shield use (the flag was up and the server had the off hand in use in every probe; note 676 already raises it again when a meal or draw ended it). **Measured on a scratch server** (26.1.2, port 25733, a bot in iron with an iron sword and shield against a summoned wither skeleton with a stone sword, resistance and saturation so each blow is counted): the shield held up and faced, 12 swings of its arm, no blow landed; the swing reflex looping as it runs during an asking, 15 blows of 15 landed in each of five 20-second runs; the guard (wither-guard.js) in 250 ms pieces as now run during an asking, 0 in five runs (two skeletons: 1 to 3 blows a run); the guard asked again every 2.5 s with a 0.5 s question, lowered at each asking (before) 6 blows over five runs, kept up (after) 1. Tried and dropped: striking only right after the skeleton's blow or when it cannot be at its reach before the shield blocks again (a stricter window from the jar's timings) did worse (2 to 11 blows in 20 s against none), the skeleton struck again 150 ms after a blow it had just landed on the shield when the bot's swing knocked it back (its attack goal restarting sets its cooldown to nothing), and with two skeletons the bot stopped swinging and the flanker hit it 13 to 22 times; the guard's own rule (strike while each biter at its reach has just struck or it is out of reach) stands. **Change.** survival.js: while encounter_stance is out, with a shield carried and a biter the guard answers at hand (in sight within four or within two), the swings are the guard's (the shield up facing it, the sword after its blow), not the swing reflex's; the step keeps the shield up where a shield stance (shield_guard, shield_the_charge) is standing with a biter at arm's length and nothing burns (`keepShieldForStance`); the stance's entry does not lower it for those two stances. wither-guard.js: the mobs' swings are kept for the bot from the first guard on (`watchSwings`), so a blow before a guard began counts in it. combat.js: SHIELD_BLOCKS_AFTER_MS (300: the five ticks and one for the raise to reach the server). The recorder writes `shield_rising` beside `shield` in the quarter second before the shield blocks, and recent.js prints "(shield rising, not yet blocking)" for a hurt then (before note 676 'shield' in the records is only the bot's flag). shield_guard's text says a raised shield blocks only after a quarter second, a blow in that moment landing whole, and that the shield stays up while the stance is asked again. Tests: test/shield-stance-683.test.js (the recorded scene: the shield never lowered through the asking and a shield_guard answer, lowered for a stance that walks; the step's keep and its limits; the text), failing on main's survival.js. **Left open.** The swing reflex (defendNearby) elsewhere, in fights and in the work, still lowers the shield to strike without waiting on a biter's blow and does not face between strikes: 77 of the hits with the shield flag up in the frame before came in its runs; the guard's rule would suit it wherever a shield is carried and the mob bites, but it runs in every fight and was not re-measured. shield_at_shots (note 676's) is lowered at the step's start as before. A wither skeleton's blow can come sooner than a second after the last when a hit knocks it back; the guard's swing right after its blow is still what measured best.
684. *Working free that climbed a cell and dug back down, and a fight at a magma cube that ended before it began (the live critic's report artifacts/critic/critic-20260929T1923Z.md, findings 4 and 5; flight records 127_0_0_1-25583-Jev-2026-09-29T18-19-38-450Z (mid-243-ge) and 127_0_0_1-25597-Jev-2026-09-29T18-16-31-622Z (mid-242-gf), artifacts/midgame-mid-242-gf.log, read by script).* **25583, 19:24:31-19:25:35Z.** A food walk stalled 18 under the rock and the survival layer began working free (aim: the surface). Twenty-five unstuck_move answers in a minute: dig up, pillar (y -18 to -17), dig down (back to -18), pillar, bridge, bridge, dig up, pillar, dig up, pillar (-15), dig down (-16), dig east, dig down (-17) ... then step, step, climb and a rise straight up through the rock to y 25 at 19:24:51 (the rise had been refused from the first column: an oak fence, then gravel, in its way). At y 25 the same again: pillar (26), dig up, pillar (27), dig down (26). Jev answered none good over the next best in about a third of them, and the best listed was taken. **Cause.** Note 671's rule left out a move that takes back the move before only *from the same cell*, and the record kept no cell for a pillar: a pillar puts its block under the feet and stands the bot a cell up, so the dig underfoot that takes it away is made from another cell and was never seen as the undo; the pillar into a cell just dug down into, the same. And each move was judged against the last alone, nothing saying what the last minute of them had gained toward the aim. **Changes.** (1) *The undo judged by the cell the move changes* (unstuck.js changeOf): a dig empties its cell, a placed block or a pillar's block under the feet fills one; a move that changes the cell the move before changed the other way is not offered, wherever it is made from, and said in here.notOffered (the move before only, and within a minute: a column dug down ten moves ago can be pillared back up). The record now keeps the pillar's cell, each move's time and where it left the aim's measure. (2) *A minute of moves judged by the aim* (judgeMinute): the height for the surface, the distance from where it got stuck for off a spot, and out of the water a cell not stood on before. Said to Jev in the state as lastMinute ("9 moves in the last 60 s: y -18 to y -17, the best y -16; the best before them y -16"). With six or more moves in a spell at least a minute long and no new best in its last minute, no move is asked: the spell escalates to the stall's question (decisions escalate, the ledger's escalation with what the minute gained), and is kept (goal.unstuck.escalated). (3) *Not begun again unasked* (work.js, the survival layer's stall): within five minutes and four blocks of where a spell ended so, the stall does not start working free again on its own; the stall's question still offers work_free, with the last spell's minute said on it ("The last: working free from about here 1 min ago ended on a minute of moves that gained nothing: ..."), and a spell Jev chooses so gets its own minute. The sentence naming lastMinute in unstuck_move's guidance was tried and taken out: it moved basalt-delta-walk-off-25583 from walk_off 4 of 5 (main) to none good 4 of 5, twice. **25597, 19:12-19:18Z.** *The "Preempted by push ... a deadly drop beside it" fired 20+ times* was one preemption (19:12:01; the log's [arbiter] lines have 15 in the whole trial): the recorder frames every step while goal.lastError is set as an error frame, and recent.js printed each (34 in six minutes). recent.js now prints an error once and counts the step frames it stood on. *The fight*: at 19:14:15, on the two-block perch the unstuck spell had just pillared (aim off the spot, where a pillar gains no distance), a big magma cube 7.5 blocks off, Jev chose fight 0.69. The run at it found no route and the fight ended at once: the hold that waits for a walker to come (eight seconds, note 552) is only for WALKERS coming now, and a magma cube is neither a walker nor, between its hops, coming; marked unreachable twenty seconds, the next askings were retreat ("No way out"), hold on the span, none good 0.74 and escalated, and a hit knocked the bot off the perch (20 to 15.2 to 12.2). The same at 19:16:10 (fight, a second later retreat, bunker) and 19:17:13 (fight, then bunker). *The step back*: fight_from_footing (step to firm ground three from any drop, then fight) was offered only where the drop cost half the health or more; the eleven-block drop 2 off cost 8 of 20, so no step back from the edge was on offer. **Changes.** (4) *A slime or magma cube in sight within its follow range comes on* for the fight's hold (survival.js HOPPERS): it hops at the player it sees (Slime's MoveControl), so a run that finds no way to it holds the fight facing it, shield up, and the eight seconds without it a block nearer still end it. (5) *The step to firm ground is offered beside any drop a knock over hurts*, the fall's cost said as before; weighing 8 of 20 against the step is Jev's (no hidden threshold). **Tests** (test/unstuck-minute-684.test.js): the dig underfoot after a pillar and the pillar into a cell just dug down into are not offered, both said, and are offered without that move before or a minute on; the minute judged (a cell up and back gains nothing, a new height does, under a minute not judged, out of the water a new cell); working free with a minute of such moves recorded throws the stall with it said, asks Jev nothing, and rests from about there only; the hoppers' hold and the footing's condition read from the source. start-underground-671.test.js: the undo from another cell is now left out too. npm test 2574: 2572, the two failing (the lava-sea cell walk, out of lava into water) pass alone and are timing under the trials' load; JEV_ARBITER=shadow 2573 of 2574, the creeper fuse text (0.4 against 0.5 seconds left), which fails on main the same; replay suite 93 of 98 with the 3 known gaps, bridge-sword-piglin-cannot-get-up (fails on main the same) and basalt-delta-walk-off-25583 (walk_off 5 of 5, twice, once the guidance sentence was out). **Still open:** the fight's estimate prices thirteen magma cubes, the big one's split two generations counted at once (40 damage, "more than the bot has"), where the children come only as their parent dies and one body takes a hit at most each half second; the rise straight up refused for a fence or gravel over one column is not looked for from the columns beside; none of this has run live.
688. *The fortress search turned back over the ground it had just searched (25598, mid-243-hb, the user: "98 seems confused", 21:05 to 21:12Z on 2026-09-29; flight record 127_0_0_1-25598-Jev-2026-09-29T20-56-27-904Z, read by script; all flight records from 12:00Z measured by scripts/leg-backtrack.js).* **What the bot did.** The search began at the portal (1, 41, 3) at 20:48:37Z and went south, west, north, south, west, north, west, the floor west and west again, a zigzag in a band of z 126 to 222 marching west. Leg 10 (21:06:49, leg_west 0.51) walked by the pathfinder from (-366, 42, 132) down to the lava sea at (-448, 32, 141), with 20 blocks. There the crossing ran out of blocks (the lava a block down), the tunnel made nothing, and after four failed tries and twenty seconds the sweep turned with "No way on in this direction. Turning the search." At 21:07:55 fortress_leg was asked with legsSoFar 11: leg_east 0.20, leg_north 0.19, seek_fortress_height 0.18, leg_south 0.18 (confidence 0.09). leg_east went back over the leg just walked, to (-358, 42, 142) in 28 seconds; then leg_south ran out of blocks again (1 carried), restock_blocks, a wooden pickaxe, leg_south, leg_east. **Why the leg back was offered and chosen.** Every heading is offered unless closed or resting; nothing rests a heading for being seen. The leg back said the facts ("This is back the way the last leg came", "Mostly seen: ... about 6 chunks are unseen", "stood on 69 of the 96 blocks"), but about 1,100 characters in, after the cells and blocks, and it was the one leg that did not run out of blocks: the three fresh ones ran out 19 or 20 cells in, over lava a block down, and the restock offered 2 blocks (1,430 netherrack within 16 not diggable from ground walked to). **Why "No way on".** Not a wall and not the pathfinder: the leg's own record said "out of blocks (20 carried)"; the chat line said nothing of that. **Measured** (flight records from 12:00Z, 382 files, 2,502 fortress_leg asks, 1,232 legs chosen): 324 legs chosen (26%) went over ground more than half seen, 263 of them with a leg half unseen or more on offer; 235 back the way the last leg came (78 of them more than half seen); 89 on a line stood on for more than half its blocks. 63 fortresses found (a fortress_approach with none on that port in the ten minutes before), with a median of 10 legs before each (mean 14.7, most 65); searches unfinished at the end of the records: 25584 77 legs, 25583 46, 25590 45, 25585 45 and others. **Change.** (1) Each leg's words (leg_*, floor_*) lead with what it is for: "Unseen ahead: about 6 of 131 chunks (5%), mostly seen already", how much of its line the bot has stood on, and "Its end is 381 blocks from where the search began (the bot is 472 from there now)" (src/nether-coverage.js headingSays, shorter than before; the search's start is kept as fortressSearch.origin). The leg back over the last leg says so plainly, at the end of its words: "Back over the last leg's own line: that leg began 84 blocks east of here, and this one's first 84 blocks go over the ground it just searched, already looked over from there." (coverage.backSays). Said first as "ground just walked", the recorded question went leg_east 10 of 10: the known walk read as the sure way. (2) widen_search: the next side of a square spiral round where the search began, clockwise, each ring 96 blocks past the last (coverage.spiralSide, read from where the bot stands, up to 192 blocks, turning out to the next ring from the west side); offered where the level leg that way is, with its unseen ground and where it ends; state.legLength carries its length to the leg's target. Without Jev it is taken where its heading is among the most unseen. (3) The guidance says a leg's worth is the new ground it looks over, not the blocks it walks (legsClosed said shorter, to stay under the question's ceiling). (4) The turn says why: "No way on west from here: out of blocks (20 carried). Choosing another way." **Probes** (live Jev, the recorded questions with the leg texts rewritten from their recorded numbers, scripts in the session's scratchpad): 24 recorded questions where a leg over more than half seen ground was chosen with a fresher one on offer, 3 asks each: picks over more than half seen ground 58 of 72 with the recorded texts, 36 of 72 with these (both under the new guidance); widen_search taken once. 25598 at 21:07:55: recorded texts leg_south 10 of 10 in the probe (leg_east 0.20 live); the first wording (the way back said first) leg_east 10 of 10; as now seek_fortress_height 8 or 9 of 10, leg_north the rest. 25598 at 18:28:34 (leg_east recorded, 64% seen): recorded texts leg_east 10 of 10; as now leg_east 2 to 6 of 10 over four runs of ten (leg_west and leg_south the rest): the guidance's words move it (without its sentence on open air over a deep drop, leg_east 6 of 10). Replay cases leg-mostly-seen-over-a-fresh-one-25598 and leg-back-over-last-leg-out-of-blocks-25598 (trimmed of the region rule, run clock, healing and rods to come under the ceiling). **Tests**: npm test 2617 of 2617, the same under JEV_ARBITER=shadow; replay suite 96 of 103 with 3 known gaps, fortress-1-block-off-21-up-90-blocks-no-pickaxe (5 of 5 run again alone), basalt-delta-walk-off-25583 (flaky list) and leg-mostly-seen-over-a-fresh-one-25598 (leg_east 4 of 5 in that run, before the guidance's open-air sentence was put back; 7 of 10 after). test/leg-widen-688.test.js (the spiral's sides, clockwise and out from the west side; the legs lead with unseen ground and end against the start; the way back said at the end with how far; widen_search offered, taken with its length, the next leg 96 again; the fallback; the turn's reason), test/nether-coverage.test.js and test/mob-hunt.test.js reworded. **Not measured live**: no trial was run. **Left**: the case at 21:07:55 is a trap of blocks more than of legs (at the lava sea with 19 blocks, every fresh leg ends 20 cells in, and the restock reaches 2 of 1,430 netherrack); the spiral's ring is round the search's start, which after a fortress is left stays where the search first began; a side cut short is picked up from wherever the bot stands, not where the side began.
689. *One committed intention at a time: an answer that takes time is what the bot is doing until it arrives, is done or fails, and the other loops' questions do not replace it (the user: "98 seems confused", "I don't know what my Jev is doing"; the live critic's reports artifacts/critic/critic-20260929T2008Z.md, -2032Z and -2054Z, Fable, notes 654, 678 and 682; flight records of 2026-09-29 12:00Z to 21:20Z, 286 files, read by script: scripts/overridden.js, new).* **What 98 did** (25598, 20:56 to 21:12Z, flight record 127_0_0_1-25598-Jev-2026-09-29T20-56-27-904Z): at full health on a fortress search with a pickaxe, fortress_leg answered leg_north, leg_south, leg_west, leg_north, leg_west, floor_west, leg_west, leg_east, leg_south, restock_blocks, leg_south and leg_east in fifteen minutes, from (-49, 42, 169) to (-449, 32, 142) and back east to (-364, 46, 306); each change of heading came after the leg before ended ("No way on in this direction. Turning the search": blocks running out over open air and lava, 19 carried against 30 to 56 to lay), not from another loop. What a person watching heard was "I'm looking for a fortress (leg 11)", "(leg 12)", "(leg 13)" with no heading and no why, then "I'll make an iron pickaxe", "Let me put together a wooden pickaxe" and "I'm back! I'll carry on where I left off": the search reversing without a word of which way or what for. **Measured** (scripts/overridden.js, the answers that start an action that takes time, src/intention.js TIMED): 4,391 in the window; 805 (18%) were replaced within thirty seconds by another question's answer with no failure frame, death or change of dimension between (745 by a question about the plan, 60 at a stall or the rung's question), and 391 more ended within thirty seconds after a failure of their way was before Jev (a walk that found no route, its `stretch`, the approach's `failed` list). The largest: fortress_visit go_in -> fortress_approach keep_searching 86 (25581 at 20:32:42, go_in 0.98 and "Leaving this fortress for now" a second later with nine blazes in sight), fortress_leg fetch_stems -> nether_gather without 62, back_to_fortress -> keep_searching 60, walk_route -> fortress_leg back_to_fortress 32, leave_nether go_back -> nether_gather leg_west 12 (note 678). **Root cause.** Each loop asks its own question on its own pass (findFortressStep asks the visit, then the approach; the step's gathering asks nether_gather; the food and portal loops theirs), and every question offers every way, leaving included, whatever was chosen a second before. Nothing held what had been chosen: an answer lasted until the next question of any loop came, and notes 678 and 682 patched pairs of them (a failure said on its option, a set-aside not offered back from the same spot). **Change** (src/intention.js, new; src/decisions/index.js decide): (1) An answer Jev chose (not the one way taken unasked) that starts an action that takes time is the bot's intention, `goal.intention`: the question and answer, its target (the option's, the question's, or for a trip through the portal the nearest portal known there, else the one come through), when, the dimension and the health. The bot says it in chat as it starts, plainly, with its why: "Going back to the spawner at (-108, 77, 155): 2 more rods needed.", "Going back through the portal for food at (-20, 71, 19): hunger 20, health 20.", "Going into the fortress at (...): 5 more rods needed." (the legs say their own line, now with the heading: "I'm looking for a fortress (leg 12, heading east)", src/narration.js). (2) It ends only by its end, read at each question: arrived (within four blocks of its target), the dimension changed, its own ledger entry settled blocked, impossible or done (tried.js), an escalation since it began (its ways below all resting, or a question under it spent), a death, four or more health lost since it began (a real change), or ten minutes gone (said as lapsed); or when Jev chooses otherwise where that is on offer: its own question asked again, a question asked at a real change (stillness_detour, rung_progress), or an answer that leaves it (keep_searching, leave_fortress, without, set_aside_rung, other_way). How it ended is kept (`goal.intentionEnded`) and said to the next plan question for two minutes (`lastIntention`). (3) While it holds, a question about the plan (fortress_leg, fortress_approach, fortress_visit, nether_gather, leave_nether, nether_food_kit, restock_food, empty_spawner, portal_way, bastion_raid) other than its own is asked with it said (`underWay`: "go in (fortress visit, to (-108, 77, 155)), chosen 1 second ago; it holds until it arrives, is done or fails; not offered while it holds: keep searching") and without the options that would replace it. A question that is the way of the intention keeps its ways and loses only its leaving: fortress_approach under go_in, back_to_fortress, go_to_blazes, go_to_spawner or unwalked (keep_searching withheld), fortress_visit under back_to_fortress and the walks to blazes (leave_fortress, go_back, get_food_here and hoglin_hunt withheld), restock_food under a restock_food chosen above it, and nether_gather under any intention, since it is asked for what the step under way needs (without withheld; its walks are the means, and after them the intention goes on, noted as its `way`). Any other question keeps only options whose target is within sixteen blocks of the intention's (nether_gather's portal_trip under go_back). A question with nothing that carries the intention on sets it down, said so ("set down: fortress visit was asked and none of its options carries it on"), and is asked whole: a fortress seen mid-leg is Jev's to take. The survival layer's questions, upkeep, and the stall's and rung's questions are asked as always; the survival layer takes the turn and hands it back with the intention still held. (4) scripts/overridden.js replays the flight records through these rules twice, as answered and with the gate. **Before and after on the records** (the same 286 files; with the gate an answer it would not have offered is counted and the intention goes on, so the record after it is the withheld answer's, not what would have followed): replaced within thirty seconds by another plan question 745 before, none after; 727 answers would not have been offered; replaced at a stall or the rung's question 43; 613 set down by a question none of whose options served it (148 of them downstream of a withheld answer), most of them a fortress or its approach found mid-leg (leg -> fortress_visit go_in, leg -> fortress_approach) or the approach's parent asked on the floors (walk_route -> fortress_leg back_to_fortress, 22). On 25598's window: 22 intentions, one replaced before, a set-down after. **Tests.** test/intention-689.test.js: go_in chosen, the approach is asked without keep_searching, with it said, and the chat line says it; the escalation, arrival and four health lost each end it and leaving is offered again; a walk back to the portal keeps nether_gather's walks and portal_trip, not without, and stays the intention through them; a fortress_visit asked mid-leg sets the leg down and is asked whole, and a stall's return_for_food replaces what held; without a bot or goal nothing is gated. The approach's own wording tests whose stand-in chose go_in and then left (test/mob-hunt.test.js, test/cross-by-hand-669.test.js, test/fortress-pier-613.test.js, test/fortress-wall.test.js) run with the gate off (JEV_INTENTION=0) or with the visit off, as recorded before note 638. npm test 2618 of 2618; JEV_ARBITER=shadow on the decision, fortress, arbiter, ledger and lean tests 191 of 191 (the full shadow run not made: the machine is loaded). Replay suite 95 of 101, 3 known gaps: basalt-delta-walk-off-25583 (on the flaky list) and fortress-leg-spawner-known-full-health-25589 (go_to_spawner 2 of 5; 5 of 5 run again; nothing gated without a bot or goal, and the recorded states carry no underWay). **Not measured live**: no trial was run. **Measure next**: in the next Nether trials, `node scripts/overridden.js --since <start>`: plan-question replacements within thirty seconds should be none, the set-downs read one by one, and the [intention] lines in the bot log (what was withheld); whether withholding keep_searching after go_in keeps a bot at a fortress it cannot reach longer than before (25590, critic-20260929T2054Z item 1: its ways rest after two failures each and escalate, and the intention ends there). **Left**: 98's own search turned west, east, south and east again by its legs' ends, each asked after a failure (the legs' choice over ground already walked is the search's, not this); the own question asked again while its answer is under way (fortress_leg re-asked 6 seconds after restock_blocks) is still asked whole: the ledger cannot yet tell a restock done from one under way.

It had laid furnaces round itself for cook_food at 20:00Z, and unstuck_move's options said "2 of the 6 blocks round it its own (furnace, laid from 20:00Z)"; place_north and the other place moves (95 in the hour) clicked against whatever solid face was first, a furnace among them. At 20:06:14 earn_xp's copper smelt opened a furnace and shut it (which shuts whatever was open), and at 20:07:13 the sticks and a stone pickaxe were made at once. (b) 25598 at 18:59:25 and 18:59:27, looting the fortress's two chests with full pockets: the log has "[room] for gold_ingot: Jev chose drop_0 (32 leaf_litter)", then "drop_12 (3 cooked_mutton)" and "drop_15 (12 cooked_beef)". The room question (inventory-tidy.js jevMakesRoom) listed every stack, food marked only "food"; the mutton was picked back up, the beef not, and 0.85 seconds later restock_food was asked with nothing to eat. No chat line said it. The same on 25588 at 21:12:00Z, on a later attempt of the stone pickaxe rung: "[room] for stick: Jev chose drop_9 (3 cooked_beef)", unsaid (with the crossing not yet next, still offered after this change, and now said). In the 128 midgame logs kept since 2026-09-26, 37 of 210 room drops were food (8 cooked beef stacks, 11 cooked mutton, 11 mutton, 6 beef, a golden apple; 1,358 food points). Two more ways food left a pack found in the code: the stash's kit slot takes the safe food over 12 points, also on the valuables trip before the Nether (stashValuables), and packing light for a bastion (in the Nether) left food over 20 points in the chest. **Root cause.** A place move clicked an interactable block standing up, and nothing closed the window it opened; a craft's failure was the answer's, not the bot's. And nothing kept the food where it is all there is. **Change.** (1) unstuck.js place: a face that does not open on a click first (skills.js `opensOnClick`: pathfinder's interactable list and the newer ones); against one only, crouched, as a player places; after the click any window left open is closed (`closeStrayWindow`). craft() closes a stray window before the grid is clicked and says in the timeout when one was found between the two clicks. (2) src/craft-failures.js: a craft whose output never came is noted (item, time, place, reason); every gameplay question carries `craftingFailed` ("Crafting stick made nothing twice in the last 30 seconds (the last 9 seconds ago: no output: ...). It rests 5 minutes more."); two in ten minutes rest the item's craft five minutes (the ledger's own REST_AFTER, WINDOW_MS, REST_MS), refused at once as Blocked with those words, so the answer that asked for it settles blocked with them; a craft that makes its output ends the run. (3) src/food-keep.js `foodStays`: in the Nether ("the food carried is all there is: nothing there reliably gives meat, and more is a trip home"), and in the Overworld while the crossing is ahead (goal.preparingNether, or the win ladder's next stage enter_nether), safe food is kept: not listed in the room question (its state says `foodNotListed` and why), no food slot in the stash's deposits (nor on the valuables trip), all of it taken on a trip packed in the Nether. Where food may go, it is said: "Dropping 3 cooked beef (24 food points) to make room for the stick.", "Put ... in the chest; N food points stay in my pockets.", and the pack-light line names the food left. A physical rule (where more cannot be had), not a judgment; nothing else in the room question changed. **Tests.** test/food-and-crafts-690.test.js: in the Nether no food is offered to drop for a gold ingot and the question says why; with the crossing ahead the same, with none ahead a food drop happens and is said; the stash takes no food before the Nether, with the crossing ahead or in the Nether, and does with nothing ahead; a bastion pack in the Nether keeps all 12 beef; the rest and its words at once and twice and after five minutes; upkeep carries `craftingFailed`; a stray furnace window is closed; place_north goes against stone beside a furnace, and against a furnace alone crouched; sticks crafted through acquireStep with a furnace window open (the mocked server refuses grid clicks while one is) are made after the window is closed, and a grid that makes nothing fails twice then is refused as Blocked with the rest said (16 s: the craft's own 4-second waits). home-stash.test.js's walk home before the Nether no longer stores the two steaks. npm test 2622 of 2622; JEV_ARBITER=shadow 2622 of 2622. Replay suite 95 of 101: bridge-sword-piglin-cannot-get-up and span-ghast-walled-toward-push (flaky list), the three known gaps, and fortress-leg-spawner-known-full-health-25589 (back_to_fortress 2 and 3 of 5, the same on main at edcccd6c run alone: not this change). **Not measured live**: no trial was run. **Left**: the flight record keeps no open window (a `window` field in the snapshot would have shown 25588's furnace directly); note 664's 6,608 points are not re-counted here (the room drops above are 1,358 of the logged ones); other raw placeBlock callers (shore.js, bunker.js) place against what they find and are not changed, though craft() now closes what they might leave open.

Its chat said "Going back through the portal for a pickaxe and blocks ... no pickaxe, 146 blocks carried" while the option said "for a pickaxe and wood", and the option's portal read "worked out from its Overworld side as near 0, 27, 217 blocks off". (b) 25585's no_route every ~14 s from 22:10 to 22:16Z was not walk_to_1: it was the warped sweep (warped-pearls.js) hand-digging a netherrack tunnel east, a few blocks between navigations, each navigation "no route" in a tunnel with no pickaxe. It never goes down the pillar, and the netherrack is 70 blocks off. **Measured** (scripts/instant-failures.js; an error or no_route frame within 2 s of the answer and before the next question, the survival layer's interruptions not counted): 18,154 answers weighed by Jev since 18:00Z, 7,615 followed by another question within 2 s; of 10,701 plan answers (stance questions aside), 632 (5.9%) failed within 2 s: stillness_detour 157 of 595, fortress_leg 124 of 1,365, upkeep 116 of 1,525, nether_gather 56 of 900, rung_progress 46, fortress_approach 25; the first failure "no route" 450 times. Runs of three or more plan answers within 5 s: 1,057, holding 4,172 answers; the commonest steps fortress_approach keep_searching -> fortress_leg back_to_fortress 71, back_to_fortress -> keep_searching 52, walk_route -> keep_searching 48, nether_gather without -> upkeep fetch_stems 48, upkeep fetch_stems -> without 41, without -> leave_nether search_on 35. nether_gather without was taken 276 times, 196 of them saying "none other is open now", and 155 of those were followed within 2 s by another question (search_on 32, fetch_stems 27, carry_on 21, wait_here 19, without again 12). return_for_blocks was taken 78 times, 16 followed by nether_gather within 2 s. A crossing stopped by the span's refusal within 2 s: 3; a floor way ending "no route" within 2 s: 1. **Root cause.** An option was offered from a survey of the ground, and its run began with a check the offer did not make. The span refuses its first cell under a shooter's eye. The walk down to the floor goes by the pathfinder, which the offer never asked. The trip home walks, crosses or stairs, and with legs resting, no crossing and no pickaxe it becomes a hunt for wood. An answer that ended at once settled only when its own question was asked again, so the next loop's question came in the same second with nothing said. **Change.** (1) bridging.js `spanRefused`: the span's own check, run by `span` and `crossAlong` before each cell and read by the offers. nether_gather's crossings and its portal_trip crossing are not offered while it holds (said in waysResting: "not now, a piglin 17 blocks off can see the bot, and no span is laid while something that shoots can"). fortress_approach's cross_level is said in the state as crossLevel. nether-travel.js crossToward does not begin (madeAlready says why). (2) nether-travel.js `downRoute` and `withDownMovements`: the pathfinder's walk to the foot of the way down, with the drops and dug rock goDown allows, surveyed in wayTo. A floor way with no route is said, not offered (a survey out of time still offers it). (3) mob-hunt.js `portalTripStart`, read by both return_for_blocks offers. The trip is offered where its first move can be made: a portal in view or within 48, a leg toward it not resting, a crossing not resting or refused, or a stair with a pickaxe carried or made from what is carried (or dug by hand within 16). Otherwise it is said with why, in legsClosed or byHand. (4) nether_gather `without` with no other step open is said as the fact `without`, not offered. The ways resting say their own reason ("(Not bridging with ...)"), and the no-way error carries them. (5) src/at-once.js, read at the start of every ledgered question. The answer given last, if it starts something that takes time (intention.js TIMED), was chosen under 2 s ago with the bot within 2 blocks, and came to nothing or had a failure noted while it was being carried out (work.js noteError), and if a different question that is not its own means (a question under it or its intention's way) is now asked, is rested from where it was chosen with its reason (tried.hold, 5 minutes). The same question asked again at once is left to the ledger and note 570's quick-return rule. (6) The span case: nether-coverage.js keeps `lastGround`, the rock last stood on, ground wider than a span (five of the eight cells round the one underfoot solid), read each tick while the search runs. fortress_leg offers `back_to_ground` where fewer blocks than the leg needs can be had here and that rock lies past the restock's looks. Deciding where next" and fortress_leg leg_west with those blazes about; at 22:22:09, at 3 health, seven seconds after the last hurt, a blaze five blocks off, upkeep spare_pickaxe. **25593.** Sealed 27 blocks under the sky at 20 health, turn_priority survival about ten times, once every ten seconds, "Answer the creeper 6 blocks off (out of sight)... the stance is asked next"; no stance came: the creeper alert (arbiter.js observeReflexes) held a creeper once seen at any sight within its line plus two, while the step asks the stance for the creepers in sight or within four (encounterDanger), so the step did nothing and the idle ruling asked again after ten seconds. Measured over the flight records since 12:00Z: 245 of 1,421 back_to_wall offers were priced "About 0 damage" (27 chosen so); 128 stance or hunt asks quoted the arena's rows under "not this bot's kit"; 369 of 15,663 plan questions (upkeep 131, win_strategy 71, fortress_leg 43, fortress_approach 34, fortress_visit 26, rung_progress 21, stillness_detour 15, the rest 28) were asked within ten seconds of a health drop; 83 of 370 creeper claims on turn_priority were of one out of sight. **Changes.** (1) blaze-stand.js measuredSays: with a kit other than the arena's (an iron sword, a shield, two or more iron pieces), the runs are not said and no price is taken from them; in their place, the kit and what the difference does in the game's numbers: "without a shield every fireball that lands is taken, where the arena's shield faced to each volley let about one in 30 through; a fireball's hit is about 5 through what this bot wears, 2.5 through the arena's full iron", and a blade's swings to kill a blaze where they differ (a stone sword's four equal an iron sword's, so that is not said). (2) standCost counts a blaze out of the stand's line that comes into it at the bot's height (settlesInto) at every stand, open or pinned: a wall's back and the spawner's cell are priced with the blazes about them as a hole's mouth is. (2) movement.js SurvivalMovements.safeToBreak: a block the bot laid itself (own-blocks.js laidAt) of a building kind (shelter.js buildingMaterials) is its own to dig through on a walk; a house or portal keeps its exclusion, and a chest, bed or obsidian is never dug so. On the 25591 ground a walk from the pocket to the bridge's floor finds a route through its netherrack; with the same netherrack not its own it is noPath, as the trial had. (3) unstuck.js digSeconds by hand: the game's five times the hardness, offered for the bot's own blocks, netherrack and the fortress's bricks ("Dig the netherrack east, at head height, a block the bot laid itself at 22:37Z (about 2 s by hand, and it drops nothing)", the bricks about 10 s); taking up a floor block by hand is not offered, as nothing drops to pick up; ownSays names a laid block of a natural kind. Nothing it waits for comes: ..."), unless every option is such a wait (then each says it on itself); the stances' questions (SAY_ONLY) keep theirs. Since 2026-09-28: 115 of 2,595, 1.72 of 36.9 h (1.09 of 20.4 standing), 97 of them pocket stays in the Nether with nothing about (1.35 h). The rest are waits for something that comes: Overworld nights in a pocket (81.6 of the 134 pocket minutes since 18:00Z, daylight), furnace batches, rests with work on offer (note 675's upkeep beside them). **Tests**: test/waits-698.test.js on test/fixtures/waits-698.json (25591's two leave_nether frames: the idle wait for each recorded cause not offered and said, with work on offer offered with its end named; a held idle wait_here asked again; the helper's words for a rest, daylight, health, the spawner, a timer; decide's gate, the all-waits case and the stances; a Nether pocket with nothing about); test/rest-wait-675.test.js's idle cases now read the wait as not offered. npm test 2686 of 2686, the same under JEV_ARBITER=shadow; replay suite 99 of 104 (bridge-sword-piglin-cannot-get-up, flaky, and fortress-leg-spawner-known-full-health-25589 at 3 of 5, 4 of 5 on its own; the suite asks with no bot and trees without `waits`, so the gate changes nothing there). **Left**: the stances' holds (hold_on_span, wait_far_off, the pillar's hold) are said, not taken out (note 521); keep_on, carry_on and defer go on with work and are not waits; how long a hold with work on offer lasts when that work fails at once (25591's fetch_stems under a skeleton) is note 697's; not measured live.

The rule is said while it holds ("it holds until it arrives, is done or fails, or walks 3 minutes with nothing gained"), and after a minute without a gain so is that. 701. *Low health in a blaze fight: a meal ended by the shield it had not asked for, and stances asked in a blaze's line at a health one fireball ends (the live critic's report artifacts/critic/critic-20260929T2326Z.md item 2: 25597 mid-242-jg, 23:26:07 to 27Z, flight record 127_0_0_1-25597-Jev-2026-09-29T23-16-57-179Z; Fable's check-in artifacts/fable/checkin-20260929T2250Z.md: 25581 answered corner_ambush twice at 2.2 health with four blazes in sight; the flight records since 2026-09-29T12:00Z read by scripts/low-health-record.js, new).* **What the bot did (25597).** Nine blazes within sixteen of a spawner; behind_cover answered at 23:26:07.2 and 09.5, and the shot hold (shot-reflex.js, note 676) on from then; a fireball and its fire, 20 to 12.1. At 23:26:15.393 encounter_stance answered eat 0.68 (beef, hunger 17; its words: about 2.6 damage while it eats, 2 of the 4 shooters with a line); 34 ms later shot_answer answered shield_up 0.58. Hunger stayed 17; the shield was up in every frame after, and the fireballs at 17.28 and 17.83 did not land. At 22.954 encounter_stance answered fight_at_spawner 0.21 at 12.1 health, the eat not on offer (a meal cut is kept off for ten seconds, MEAL_CUT_MS); on the walk into their fire a fireball took 12.1 to 8.2 with the shield down, fire and another fireball 6.2 to 2.3, dead at 23:26:27. **Why the meal was not eaten.** A shield and a meal are each a use of a hand, and the server keeps one use at a time: a use of the off hand ends the meal, and a release ends whatever is in use. With the hold on, three things in the code end a meal: the hold's raise for a shield_up answer due or a shot on its way (combat.raiseShield); raiseShield raising again when the server's flags no longer show the shield (note 676's check, which a meal begun under a raised shield trips); and the hold's refusal once the server says the main hand is in use ('eating or drawing a bow', holdRefused), which lets go at once and lowers the shield it had raised by a release (combat.lowerShield, deactivateItem) that ends the meal, the shield being no longer what is in use. The frames do not show which came first (no packet-level record); the hold was on at the choice and the shield up at 23:26:16.1 and 17.1, and no hurt came between 15.16 and 23.10, so not a hit or its knockback. **Measured** (flight records since 12:00Z): 94 meals chosen as a stance in the Nether, 90 eaten within four seconds; the shot hold was on in none of the 90, and in 2 of the 3 not eaten with the bot alive (the third a hurt with the shield up): rare, and when the hold is on the meal is not eaten. 82 deaths in fights with blazes (blaze-record.js fights()): in 42 the last stance was chosen under 6 health, 39 of them with a blaze seeing the bot as it was chosen (corner_ambush 8, close_in 7, leave_and_heal 6, retreat 5, back_to_wall, shield_guard and take_cover 3 each); in 50 of the 82 it was chosen at or under the one-shot line (a blaze's fireball through the armour worn and the four its fire takes: 6.5 in full iron, 9 in none) with a blaze seeing the bot. **Changes.** (1) src/meal.js (new): a meal the bot chose (the eat stance, step_out_and_eat, the golden apple) is marked while it is eaten (bot._meal) and eaten through (eatThrough): the hand settled, the eat begun, and begun again after a cut by a shot (three tries at most, while a meal still helps), eaten meaning hunger or saturation up (the apple: one fewer). combat.js: raiseShield raises nothing while a meal is on and not cut; lowerShield sends no release while a meal is on or the server says the main hand is in use. shot-reflex.js: while a meal is on no warning's answer holds the shield; a shot in the air on a line that hits and lands inside the meal, no sooner than the quarter second a raised shield takes to block, cuts it (cutMeal, the why kept) and the hold raises and faces it as before (holdRefused does not refuse a meal so cut); the meal is begun again once no shot is on its way (shotComing, at most four seconds' wait); a shot landing after the meal, or too soon to block, leaves the meal alone. (2) The eat option says whether the meal is done before a shot can land (meal.finishSays): the shooters with a line here, each at its next shot (a blaze by its glow and rest, blaze-stand volleyIn; a bowman's draw or a ghast's mouth by its warning, else about a second), against the 1.9 seconds the meal takes from now, and with a cage within sixteen the spawner's next try (spawner-clock nextTry) and that a new blaze glows three seconds before it shoots: "Not done before a shot: the blaze 8 blocks off, with a line here, shoots in about 0.9 seconds, inside the 1.9 seconds the meal takes from now. A shot on its way raises the shield, which ends the meal; it is begun again once the shots are past." or "Done before any shot lands here: ...". (3) step_out_and_eat (encounter_stance, new): with a shooter's line here and a spot out of every line within eight blocks of walking (out_of_sight's spot, bunker.coverWithin), walk there and eat, priced as the walk in their fire and then the meal where only what comes round to a line (lineRegained) or to arm's length reaches it. (4) src/lethal-line.js (new), survival.stanceStep: where one shot that lands ends the bot (a shot's hit through the armour worn, MOBS and afterArmour, and a blaze's fire with the fire already on the body, landingsToEnd; a blaze not counted under fire resistance) and a shooter has a line to it, the bot first walks to the nearest cell out of every shooter's line (coverWithin, eight blocks) or puts a block in each line (creeper-sight blockPlan), whichever is sooner (4.3 blocks a second, 0.6 seconds a block); the stance is asked at the next look with oneShotEnds in its facts, the threshold in numbers ("At 5 health one shot that lands ends the bot: a blaze's is about 5 through the armour worn, and the fire it sets about 4 more. A blaze has a line to it here. The rule at a health where one shot ends it: out of every shooter's line first ..., then the stance is asked.") and what was done ("Just now: walked 1 block to (0, 65, 1), where no shooter's line reaches."). A stance chosen with that said is not stepped out of again while it holds (lethalKnown); one chosen above the line is asked again once the rule has acted (lethalAgain, said in previousStance). With no way out, or one that failed from this cell in the last fifteen seconds, the stance is asked with that said. The registry (src/decisions/survival.js) says the eat's and shot_answer's new rules, the new option and the rule. **Tests** (test/low-health-701.test.js): 25597's scene, a shield_up answer due with the meal on neither raising the shield nor releasing it (fails on main's reflex and combat); a fireball landing inside the meal cutting it, one landing after it not (fails on main); a cut meal begun again and eaten; finishSays; the one-shot line at 6.5 in full iron and 8.9 in none, none behind a wall; at 5 health with a blaze in line the step walking out of it before asking, and the stance asked after carrying oneShotEnds and what was done; step_out_and_eat offered with the eat's new words. npm test 2713 of 2713, the same under JEV_ARBITER=shadow; replay suite 100 of 106 with the 3 known gaps (it asks recorded trees with no bot, so none of this runs there; bridge-sword-piglin-cannot-get-up and leg-mostly-seen-over-a-fresh-one-25598 among the failures, both on the flaky list). **Not changed:** the ten seconds a failed meal is kept off the list (MEAL_CUT_MS) stand, now said with the cut's why; the rule's walk waits behind a shield the shot hold raises for a shot on its way (the body lock), and fails with that said if the hold outlasts it; the five-second gap in 25597's frames (23:26:17.9 to 22.8, no observation) was not looked into; none of this has run live.

703. *An angry group, a crouch that holds, a way out of fire that did nothing said, a fetch that is held, and clocks from a save (the live critic's report artifacts/critic/critic-20260930T0010Z.md, items 1 to 3; flight records of 25592 mid-242-dc-fortress-25, 25589 mid-242-cf-nether-1-fortress-25 and 25588 mid-243-hf, 2026-09-30 00:05 to 00:11Z; the flight records since 2026-09-29T12:00Z, 463 files, read by script).* **What the bots did.** (a) 25592 died at 00:09:50Z with 4 of 7 rods. The stance at 00:09:45 named "a piglin 13.2 blocks off (out of sight) ... it has no way to the bot": that was a piglin (entity 1247), named rightly. Not named at all were five zombified piglins within fifteen blocks, the nearest 2.9, 4.4 and 6.4 blocks off: calm ones are no threat, so no option or fact said them. Jev chose box_here at 00:09:46. The box's builder swings at whatever is in its reach before each block (blaze-tactics.js strikeInReach), and a zombified piglin was on that list angry or not. At 00:09:48 one of them came to 8.4 blocks from 14.1 (it had come down from y 95), and 20 went to 13.3, 6.6 and 0 in three seconds, "mob attack by zombified_piglin" each time. No strike on a zombified piglin shows in the record: the box's swings are not recorded, and they are the one swing that fits. (b) Earlier on 25592, on fire at 00:08:26 and 00:09:19 to 22, rise_on_block was chosen five times over out_of_fire. At 00:09:19, 20.5 and 22.0 the body stayed at y 81.00 on the ground through each: the rise never went up, and each asking was told nothing of the one before. (c) 25589: upkeep chose fetch_stems at 00:05:38.025. At 00:05:38.139 a wither skeleton's newcomer preemption cut it. The work came back to the fortress (return_to_blazes, then the leg at 00:05:48) and nothing held the fetch. Its keep_searching said "1145 minutes searching" 20 minutes into a trial begun from a stage save: the search's `since` came from the save, and the save had lain unplayed. return_for_blocks said "a pickaxe needs wood (none carried)" beside the portal 325 blocks off. The nearest wood known was a warped forest noticed 376 blocks west with no stem seen in it: not near, but not said either. (d) 25588 stood on a magma block at (-205, 32, -135). It chose crouch_on_hot_floor at 00:09:23, and the crouch held 44 seconds with no hurt. Meanwhile upkeep's spare_pickaxe failed four times in 33 seconds, "the crafting table did not open", with a shield in the off hand. Then the leg's walk at 00:10:07 stood the body up on the magma. The crouch was chosen again at 00:10:08, 10 and 12, and it was hurt after each (15.3 to 11.2). **Why.** (a) The game: a zombified piglin hurt by a player sets every zombified piglin within its follow range (35 blocks across, 10 up or down) on that player for 20 to 39 seconds, longer while they see the player. A piglin struck calls the adult piglins about it. The bot counted one as angry only after one of its kind had hurt the bot, and the box's swing did not ask. (b) The rise's offer checked two open cells over the feet. Its run (pillarUp) first stops at lava or water in or beside the cells risen through, and swallowed any throw (a preemption among them) as nothing done. (c) upkeep's fetch_stems was not an intention (note 689's TIMED had it for fortress_leg, the approach, the stall and the rung's questions, not upkeep). The fortress search's clocks were not among those moved on when a save is taken up (note 583 moved the ledger's only). (d) The crouch's hold let go for good the first time anything else released the key (a step's clearControlStates, a walk), the body still on the magma. And the game gives a crouched click on a block with anything in either hand to the item, not the block: a crafting table clicked crouched with a shield carried opens nothing. **Measured** (flight records since 12:00Z): 7 of 155 deaths were dealt last by a zombified piglin (25581 20:44 and 21:48, 25585 16:58, 18:35 and 20:49, 25592 00:09, 25598 17:27). 5 of 110 box_here answers had a zombified piglin within five blocks. 59 of 88 crouch_on_hot_floor answers were followed by a hot-floor hurt within ten seconds. 23 of 52 rise_on_block answers left the body at the same height 1.5 to 3 seconds later. **Changes.** (1) src/anger.js (new). The bot's own hit on a zombified piglin or a piglin, read from the server's damage event (its source is the bot), angers it and its group about where it was struck: 35 across and 10 up or down for 40 seconds for zombified piglins, 16 for 30 seconds for piglins. One with its arms up (the mob flags' aggressive bit, which the game sets while a mob's melee goal runs at a target) that is within four blocks or coming at the bot a block a second or faster is hunting it. danger.js provoked counts both, so such a one is a threat named for what it is. session.js installs the listener. (2) The box's swing (strikeInReach) takes a zombified piglin only once provoked. (3) walk-reach.js: an angry one is not "apart" for a way that only goes round past the search's twelve blocks. It hunts any way round. Only a search that closed keeps it out. The work's and risk's words say of an angry one "angry (the bot struck one of its group 3 seconds ago, 18 blocks from it): it hunts the bot with its group, any way round, from up to 35 blocks, while the anger lasts" instead of "it has no way to the bot" (arbiter.js mobWouldSays with the bot). The stance's threats carry `angry` with why. Calm zombified piglins within eight are said as calmNeutralsNear, with what a hit, a sweep too, would turn. (4) rise_on_block is offered only where pillarUp's climbStop finds nothing stopping the climb. Its words say it rises in the same spot and that the body burns on after, about a health a second, "standing on the block does not put out the fire on the body". 704. *The rods into a chest in the Nether: at the spawner and in the lull with two or more carried, counted as held, and taken out before the portal (the user: "With low life and multiple rods, is it worth storing them in a chest or something?"; the flight records 2026-09-28T00:00Z to 2026-09-30T00:19Z, read by script).* **Why.** A death drops everything carried, the bot comes back to life in the Overworld far from it, and what lies on the ground vanishes five minutes after its chunk is loaded or burns in lava; no mob opens a chest. **Measured** (scripts/after-rod.js --held, new: each time a life in the Nether first carried k rods or more, what came first): 2 or more, 137 times: 101 died with them before leaving the Nether (median 224 s after, 62 within five minutes, 367 rods lost at those deaths), 5 left with them, 31 records ended first (a restart mostly); 3 or more, 85: 67 died, 5 left; 4 or more, 63: 47 died (median 254 s), 4 left. **Change.** (1) src/rod-stash.js (new). `stash_rods` is offered in the Nether in Survival with 2 or more rods carried (powder a half each) and rods still wanted, no blaze or ghast with a line to the bot, not resting after a failure, and a chest here: one of the bot's own within twelve blocks, or a cell in reach (air on solid ground, air over it since a chest does not open under a solid block, no lava or fire within two, no body in it, not the bot's own cells, out of every blaze's and ghast's line, rock round it first) with a chest carried or the wood for one (8 planks, 4 more for a table when none is carried; a log or stem is 4; made through work.js acquireStep, a step a call). What goes in: the rods, blaze powder, ender pearls and eyes. It is offered in empty_spawner (at a known spawner with no blaze near, and in the lull, note 691) and in encounter_stance where a blaze is about and none sees the bot; said short (note 672): what goes in and where, the seconds (in the lull against the spawner's next try, spawner-clock jobSays), the making, that a chest keeps them, counted as held, taken out before the portal; the rods carried, what a death does to them and the records' row by the rods carried go in empty_spawner's state as `rodsCarried` (in the stance, on the option). Without Jev, empty_spawner's default takes it first. Run: the chest put down (work.js place), the stacks deposited through the chest window, the chest and what it holds kept in `goal.rodStashes` (position, dimension, contents as last read, times), so a restart or a death leaves it known; a failure rests the offer five minutes and is kept as `goal.rodStashFailed`. (2) Counted as held: eye-need.js `need` counts what the chests hold (rods, powder, pearls, eyes) in `rodsLeft` and `pearlsLeft`, and says it ("Carried: ...; in a chest: 4 blaze rods in a chest at (x, y, z) in the Nether"); blaze-stand.js rodsNeeded (a hunt off the ladder) and rung-measure.js's item count (putting rods in the chest is not a fall in the rung's measure) count it too. (3) Taken out before leaving: game-progress.js nextGameStage in the Nether counts the chests for the hunt (the acquire's count is what is still to be carried) and the Nether's pearl ways, and where the ladder would walk to the portal (the rods done, or the Overworld's endermen chosen for the pearls) the stage is `collect_rod_stash` first, with the chest's place and distance: walked to (navigate, passing), opened, emptied, said in chat. A chest not there is marked lost and said, and no longer counted (so the hunt goes on); one not reached three times is given up, said, and no longer counted, so the ladder does not cross and come back for it. (4) The crossing's kit (note 673) has a fourth rung, `nether_chest` (DEFERRABLE, in KIT_PHASES): a chest, or 8 planks' worth of wood with a table (12 without), said with what it is for and the records' row; with every rod needed in a chest in the Nether the kit rungs stay open for the crossing that fetches them. 705. *A false rule our own fixes made (no hand digs basalt, blackstone or bricks), plan answers in a chain from one block, a trip home said toward the fortress, and a crossing that buried its own head in gravel (the live critic's report artifacts/critic/critic-20260930T0034Z.md, items 1 and 2; 25589 mid-242-cf-nether-1-fortress-25 at 00:32:36 to 39Z and 25588 mid-243-hf at 00:26 to 00:36Z on 2026-09-30, read with scripts/trials/recent.js and the flight records by script; a scratch server on port 25705).* **What the bots did.** (a) 25589 sat 29 minutes at a known fortress with blazes about, no pickaxe, cobblestone and a crafting table carried. Its options said "Blackstone, which no hand digs (no pickaxe carried) stops it at cell 17", "the straight line to it meets basalt about 3 blocks along, which no hand digs", and upkeep's carry_on "the next 5 minutes cannot dig or stair through basalt, blackstone or nether bricks". fetch_stems said "No pickaxe is carried and none can be made from what is carried" while its own first line said the pickaxe was 1 stem (2 planks, for the sticks) short. (b) At 00:32:36 to 39 it answered nine plan questions from (163, 61, 287): fortress_leg leg_south, fortress_approach walk_route (no path at once), keep_searching ("Leaving this fortress for now"), fortress_leg go_to_blazes_about ("Going to where blazes were seen"), fortress_approach other_way, fortress_leg fetch_stems (0.05), nether_gather without, fortress_leg back_to_fortress, fortress_approach cross_level. (c) 25588 lost 8.2 to 1.2 health from 00:26:02 to 00:26:32 with its head in gravel. The flight record shows the step aside working each time: the head was out within 0.2 s and the work took the turn back. The work was a crossing (cross_toward) digging a gravel seam, and its gravel count went 16, 17, 18, 19. Each head cell it dug was filled by the gravel over it, and it stepped in. The "no_route" frames were the fortress search's, not the step aside's. At 00:32:04 it chose fortress_visit go_back and said "Going back through the portal for food at (-328, 73, -293)", the fortress; the portal known is (3, 42, 8). At 00:35:19 the same question, asked again at the same 1.2 health and hunger 9, got go_in (0.36 against go_back 0.24). **The game's rule, checked.** On a scratch server (26.1.2, port 25705, stopped and deleted after), a bare hand broke netherrack in 2.0 s, basalt 6.25, blackstone 7.5, nether bricks 10.0 and stone 7.5, each dropping nothing, and soul sand in 0.75 s, dropping. That is minecraft-data's hardness times 5 where a harvest tool is required (times 1.5 where none is), and prismarine-block's digTime agrees. **Why the chain ran.** Note 695 reads an answer that starts something and ends in its first second. Note 689's intention ends on an answer that leaves. keep_searching, other_way and without end by what they are, so each handed the turn to the next loop's question, which was asked as if first; only walk_route's no-path failure was an instant failure of the kind note 695 reads. go_to_blazes' four earlier "No path to the goal!" were said on its option. **Changes.** (1) src/hand-dig.js (new): `handRule` (breaks, seconds, drops) from the registry's hardness and harvestTools, `handSays` and `rockByHand` for the words. It is the one rule for block-stock.js `handDigs` (true for every block with a hardness; bedrock and the like not), `handLine` (seconds summed, stopping only at a block that does not break), `handWaySays`, `goingOnSays`, `pickaxeLead` and `handGather`. It also serves nether-travel.js surveyLeg (a leg digs basalt, blackstone and bricks by hand at their seconds, "12.5 seconds a cell by hand, no pickaxe carried, dropping nothing"), the stair's hand rule (tunneling.js stairChoices), cage-hold's slit, unstuck.js digSeconds (any rock by hand, not only the bot's own blocks, netherrack and bricks) and its pillar's rock, and mob-hunt.js pickaxeSays, searchReachSays, the way back's closed stair and make_pickaxe ("with it rock is dug several times faster ..."). The definitions of tunnel and seek_fortress_height say it (docs/decisions.md). work.js tunnelToward with no pickaxe makes the one the pockets make first (a few seconds, and the rock then drops); else it digs by hand where a step gains within 16 across, as before; else it gets a stone pickaxe. The pathfinder's own dig policy (movement.js blocksCantBreak: a walk digs soft ground only) is unchanged: that is what a walk is, not a claim about the hand. (2) mob-hunt.js bestMakeable with no pickaxe to be made says what it is short of (`short`: planks and stems, for which of table, sticks and head, then which pickaxe). fetch_stems says "No pickaxe is carried: it is short of 2 planks (1 stem) for the sticks, which this fetch brings; then a stone pickaxe from the cobblestone or blackstone carried. Until then rock is dug by hand and drops nothing." (3) src/plan-chain.js (new; decide): every answer to a plan question (intention.js GATED) is kept with when, where, health and hunger. The next plan question hears the answers just before it from within 3 blocks that took no time (each within 5 s of the next) as `planAnswersJustNow`. Where the last one turned back on one of them (the same topic, the other side: leaving this fortress against going to it or its blazes, going without a pickaxe against getting one, going back through the portal against going on), that is said as `reversal` ("go to blazes about (fortress leg), chosen 1 second ago, reverses keep searching (fortress approach), chosen 2 seconds ago from here: leave this fortress"). An option that would turn back on the last answer (within 10 s), or on the last answer to this same question (within ten minutes), says so on itself, with health and hunger then and now where it was 30 s or more ago. On 25588's go_in: "It turns back on go back (fortress visit), chosen 3 minutes ago (go back through the portal); health 1.2 then, 1.2 now, hunger 9 then, 9 now." After the ledger's own reading, a chain of 5 different plan answers so (the same answer again and again stays the ledger's) is not asked on. A stall is raised to the rung's question, once, with the chain and its reversals said as whatFailedBelow ("5 plan answers in the last 2 seconds from this spot, none of which took any time: ...; fortress approach was not asked again"). A ledger escalation begins the chain again. JEV_PLAN_CHAIN=0 turns it off. (4) intention.js: a trip back through the portal in the Nether takes the nearest known portal as its target, not the question's (the fortress), so the chat line, the arrival and the yield read the portal. The intention keeps hunger beside health. (5) bridging.js clear (the crossing's and span's dig of each body cell) digs a cell again as a column of gravel or sand comes down into it, until it stays open (up to 12), and only then steps in. surveyCrossing counts the column's blocks in the digs and seconds. **Not done as asked.** Taking step_aside off the offer where it "cannot route": the record shows it routed and worked every time, and the burial came from the crossing, now fixed. At 1.2 health go_in stays Jev's to choose; the reversal and the unchanged health and hunger are now said on it. **Tests.** test/note-705.test.js covers the hand rule against the scratch server's times, block-stock and unstuck by it, the short pickaxe, the 25589 chain (tags, reversal, the stop at the sixth, asked afresh after), time or movement between answers being no chain, go_back's target and chat and go_in's tag three minutes on, and the gravel column dug before stepping. test/note-687.test.js's leg, stair and fortress_leg tests now carry the rule as it is (legs through basalt offered with their seconds, the staircase offered, only bedrock stopping). note-692, note-695, note-697, nether-wood-658 and fortress-wall take the new words. **Not measured live**: no trial was run.

713. *Pearls: a solo enderman is fine, several at once are not, and recovering from a hit takes the rest of them with no defense at all (the goal's next bottleneck after rods: 13 pearls, never more than 11 carried; flight records since 2026-09-26 read by script; a scratch server, port 25713, .test-combat-713 in the main checkout, built and dropped after).* **What the records say.** Since 2026-09-26, no enderman hunt in a live trial ended with a recorded outcome at all (0 of the `pickup_confirmed`/`no_pickup`/`target_lost` results found; the same search finds 78 for spiders and skeletons): the pearl hunt almost never runs to a finish. 459 "Looking for a warped forest" chats and 345 "No warped forest found" in the same window; the `warped_search` step ran in 45,466 recorded frames against 4,822 for `warped_pearls` itself, so of the time this rung holds the turn, the bot is searching for a forest roughly nine times as long as it is standing in one fighting for pearls. **What the arena found.** `enderman_single` (one enderman, the existing drill): 6 runs on main, 1 death (killed at 8.6 health when an already-fought enderman was brought back to it while `recover_before_combat` ran, taking six more hits with nothing done about them, "Threat nearby: enderman at 1 blocks" twice, no response); 4/6 cleared, 2/6 pearls picked up (near the "about half the time" drop rate pearl-routes.js already tells Jev). Two new drills at real forest density (`enderman_forest_trio`, three endermen six to eight blocks apart, and `enderman_forest_five`, five on every side, both in a new `warped_forest` arena of warped nylium): `enderman_forest_trio`, 5 runs, 4 deaths, 0 cleared, 1 pearl total picked up over the five, 33 to 41 damage taken in every run including the one survivor (down to 2.5 health). Every death carries the same line: "Threat nearby: enderman at 1 blocks" or "at 2 blocks", a `fight` action already running, and the bot dead a few seconds later regardless. Pearls per enderman-minute, measured: about 4.2 alone (5 pearls over 8 kills at a median 8.9 s each), about 0.3 in the forest setting (1 pearl over 175 s of real encounters, with an 80% death rate in the same runs) — the density the hunt is actually sent to (warped-pearls.js) is close to un-survivable as it stands, which is the real reason no run has carried more than 11: it is not that pearls come slowly, it is that a second or third enderman drawn into the fight is usually the bot's death. **Root cause, the death.** `prepareMobHunt`'s `recover_before_combat` branch (mob-hunt.js, reached whenever the hunt judges the bot unfit to keep fighting) checked only two hazards while it waited to heal: a drop underfoot and a shooter's line. A melee mob already at arm's length, mid-fight, fell through both checks into a bare `sleep(500)` with no defense of any kind and nothing handed to Jev either. **Root cause, the crowd.** survival.js's own single-enderman answer (fight if armed and at least 8 health, else seal into a two-high pocket it cannot stand under) fires only with exactly one enderman within 8 blocks and nothing else near; once a second is drawn in — which happens in the forest simply by fighting long enough near others, sword-sweep bystanders and stares aside (both already guarded against: combat.js's `bystanders` keeps a sweep off a calm enderman, and gaze.js already turns the look away from any but the one being fought) — that fast path does not apply, the crowd falls to the general multi-mob handling, and in this drill that handling did not hold (`seal_failed` once, otherwise no stance at all recorded before death). **Changes made.** (1) src/mob-hunt.js `recover_before_combat`: a non-shooter threat within 3.5 blocks now throws `NeedsSafety` at once, the same way the existing drop and shooter cases already do, instead of sleeping through it; this alone took `enderman_single` from 1 death in 6 to 0 in 8 (median damage 4.1, 5 of 8 pearls picked up). (2) scripts/arena.js now loads `gaze.js`'s plugin on the arena bot, as session.js does for the real one: every enderman drill before this ran with the eyes-off-their-heads behavior absent, so a multi-enderman drill would have measured a bot staring blind rather than the one that actually ships. (3) scripts/lib/arena.js `sweep` (the between-attempt cleanup) pads its kill box 5 blocks past the arena's own shell: an enderman teleports on its own, away from whatever just hit it, and the exact-shell box before this missed those, so a "three endermen" drill's own spawn count crept to 4, 5, then 8 as escapees from earlier attempts went uncounted. Five blocks is the most any arena's sweep can pad without reaching into the next arena's shell (room and corridor sit twelve blocks apart, the closest pair of the nine named arenas); it is not enough to catch every escapee at a longer chase, so the forest drills' own "spawned" counts still ran ahead of the nominal 3 and 5, and the numbers above should be read as this density or a little past it, not exactly it. (4) Two new drills, `enderman_forest_trio` and `enderman_forest_five`, and their `warped_forest` arena (a warped-nylium floor, well over head, no walls near), for testing this density again. **Not fixed.** The crowd's own defense once two or more endermen are already engaged: this needs a real answer beyond the single-enderman fast path, and the arena above says plainly that it does not have one yet, but a change to it under this note's own testing budget risked more than it fixed. Pearl targeting itself (`isolated`, `claim`) was read and is fine as it stands: idle, unprovoked endermen nearby do not block a hunt from taking one (`threats()` only counts provoked mobs), and combat.js already keeps a sword's sweep off a calm bystander. Whether staring specifically (as opposed to plain proximity and time) provokes a bystander in a real forest was not isolated as its own variable; the deaths measured here were dominated by straightforward crowding, not by a confirmed stare. Fact for Jev, not a rule: fighting an enderman with another one already within a few blocks is, right now, close to a coin flip on the bot's life, and the forest the hunt is sent to has that as its normal condition, not an edge case. **Tests.** test/mob-hunt.test.js and test/enderman.test.js unchanged and passing; test/arena.test.js's sweep test updated for the pad, and a new test that no two arenas' padded sweeps reach each other on a server shared by other sessions. npm test 2752 of 2752, the same under JEV_ARBITER=shadow (the six `none_good` failures seen earlier running mob-hunt.test.js by itself do not appear under `npm test`'s own JEV_NONE_GOOD=0, and are unrelated to this note either way: confirmed present on unmodified main, before any of these changes). Replay suite 102 of 107, 4 known gaps, the one failure bridge-sword-piglin-cannot-get-up (on the flaky list). **Not measured live:** no trial has run with the `recover_before_combat` fix; the crowd gap above is reported, not closed.

706. *Half a heart with no food and no way home, a creeper asked for at every step behind its block, and one fortress named at five places (the live critic's report artifacts/critic/critic-20260930T0057Z.md items 1 and 2; 25588 mid-243-hf 00:35 to 00:59Z and 25581 mid-243-hg 00:55 to 00:58Z on 2026-09-30, read with scripts/trials/recent.js and the flight records 127_0_0_1-25588-Jev-2026-09-30T00-27-35-363Z and 127_0_0_1-25581-Jev-2026-09-30T00-27-32-583Z, and 25588's end-of-run archive).* **What the bots did.** (a) 25588 was at 1.2 health from 00:35 and 0.2 from 00:50:49 (a hit, 1.2 to 0.2), hunger 9 falling to 7, nothing to eat, in the Nether. survival_priority answered obtain_food with return_for_food eight times from 00:49:33 to 00:51:04 (hoglin_food twice, its walk ending "no route"). From 00:52:41 the walk back went to the staircase, which stalled; portal_way answered wait_rest at 00:54:28, 00:54:51 and 00:58:11 ("other work until the staircase's rest ends"), and each asking after that (restock_food, fortress_visit go_back, stillness_detour) offered the trip again, its text "421 blocks off, about 98 seconds at a walk", each run ending in its first second "The nether portal at (3, 42, 8) is 421 blocks across and 7 below and cannot be reached from here: legs of thirty-two blocks on foot toward it made no ground, and rest two minutes; a crossing straight ...". The "other work" was upkeep's fetch_stems and a spare wooden pickaxe at 0.2 health; restock_food answered keep_on ("go on without more food for twenty minutes") at 00:47:07, 00:54:52 and 00:55:54 with a bastion 278 blocks off on the same question. It died at 00:59:07 on a floor walk toward the portal. Meanwhile one fortress was named at (-328, -293), (-303, -294), (-340, -326), (-264, -308) and (-296, -309): the landmark list held one fortress, but fortressSearch.found is the nearest brick, and on each stall work.js looseEnds set aside sixteen blocks round it and dropped it, so the next pass took the nearest brick past them as a fortress found anew (the archive's shunned list: (-280, -307), (-263, -307), (-257, -292), (-261, -323), (-290, -294), (-296, -309), two to four seconds apart), and approachFortress began a new approach, its failures cleared, whenever the aim moved over 32 blocks. At 00:47:17 "Going into the fortress" and "Leaving this fortress for now" came in the same second: descend was the only way in on offer, and under 12 health the descent goes no lower, so it ended at once and keep_searching was the one way left. "Not getting any closer (attempt 10)" was the stall count, with the brick of the moment named. (b) 25581 at (96.5, 10, 54.5), 20 health: block_creeper twelve times in 24 s. Every re-ask was blockCreeperHeld (note 685's rule), five for the creeper coming 0.75 nearer at a time from 9.4 to 3.3 (the reference reset at each answer), and five for "moving within 3 blocks" while it milled at 2.5 to 3.2, out of its line, twice going no nearer (2.5 to 3, 3 to 3); one block was laid at 00:56:14 and none after. The 00:57:24 to 35 askings were mostly real (the line opened, it lit). unstuck_move eleven answers in 14 s: rise, pillar three times, bridges west, north, east (each laying a block), and dig_down taking up its own pillar block four moves after it was laid; note 684's undo rule compares with the move before only, and its minute judge needs a minute. **Changes.** (1) src/last-hit.js (new): where health is at or under the lightest blow of the dimension's mobs through the armour worn (the game's numbers, combat-estimate MOBS and afterArmour, a hoglin's least and a magma cube's smallest counted), hunger is under 18 and what is carried does not bring it to 18 (in an iron helmet and chestplate): "At 0.2 health any hit ends the bot: the lightest blow of the Nether's mobs is about 2.2 through the armour worn (a hoglin's), and a drop of four blocks costs one. Health does not come back: hunger 7, under 18, and nothing to eat carried. Only food brings it back; a way that brings none risks the end and gains no health." decide says it first (`lastHit`, the first key of the state) on every gameplay question, and survival_priority's continue_request off the Overworld adds "At 0.2 health any hit ends it, and this brings no food." (2) Going on without food (restock_food keep_on, the stall's keep_on, leave_nether's keep_on for food) is not offered while that holds; restock_food says it among the ways not offered, and leave_nether keeps it only where no other option is left. (3) mob-hunt.js portalTripStart (note 695's shared check) now reads the staircase's rest toward the portal (tunneling.js restingWay) after the legs and the crossing: with all three resting the trip cannot begin. `tripHomeClosed` says it with the portal, and every offer of the trip home reads it: survival_priority's return_for_food, foodRoutes (restock_food, the kit, empty_spawner's ways), the stall's return_for_food, fortress_visit's and empty_spawner's go_back, leave_nether's go_back for food and for the rods' wait; a held trip back for food is asked again, not walked into its first failure. game-progress.js portalTrip says "The way back to the portal (the nearest known 421 blocks off at 3, 42, 8) cannot be reached from here: ... the staircase toward it rests (...), 10 more minutes." in place of the seconds at a walk, and the questions that leave it out say it (`tripHome`). (4) survival_priority's obtain_food in the Nether offers the bastion's chests (bastion-raid.js foodRoute) beside the hoglin and the trip. (5) blockCreeperHeld: asked again when the line opens or the creeper lights, and when it comes nearer into its blast's reach of six blocks and at each whole block nearer inside it; milling within three out of its line is not asked for (the game's SwellGoal: no line, no fuse), and the option says when it is asked again.
